answer: One shared ceremony blocks fakes: a river gate opens for one random minute. Each identity flies a sparrow: a reply signed with its own key in that minute. An opal token minted at the gate seals it. A late or replayed sparrow burns the 60-credit bond. Attending costs 45; the minute cannot be booked, so a rented sparrow costs 55. Forging 1,000 identities costs 160,000 vs a 40,000 pool, a 120,000 loss. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep full share.
